title: Sariema room description
description: Which kit, placement (montagem) and lighting (luz) files make a room, and how to dress it. File paths are relative to the project's assets root.

kit.description: GLB whose scene root nodes are the pieces.

show.description: Sub-rooms (comodos) to include; the first gives the ambient light and the sun.

loose.description: Pieces that keep their own draws instead of merging by material: each copy is a node the game can show, hide and move, with every state of the piece and its hinges.

hidden.description: Pieces that start hidden. Loose ones keep invisible draws the game can show; merged ones are left out.

groups_off.description: Sub-rooms of show whose group starts switched off: built and loaded, drawn once the game switches the group on.

shadowless_lights.description: Lights, named <room>.<nome>, that cast no shadow.

ao_strength.description: How much light screen-space ambient occlusion takes from fully occluded creases; 0 turns it off. 0.5 when absent.

ao_radius_m.description: How far, in metres, a surface occludes another. 0.5 when absent.

extra_hemisphere.description: A hemisphere light added to the one luz.json gives the first room in show, for one the game creates in code.

character_light.description: Light only actors receive, so they read against the room. Every field is optional; the defaults leave actors lit as the room is.

direction.description: Towards the fill in the camera's frame: x right, y up, z towards the viewer. [0.3, 0.6, 1] when absent.

color.description: Linear RGB of the fill and the rim. White when absent.

intensity.description: The fill's strength in the sun's units; it casts no shadow and gives no highlight. 0 when absent.

wrap.description: How far the fill reaches past the side it faces: 0 is Lambert's cosine, 1 lights all but the far side. 0.5 when absent.

rim.description: Light along the silhouette, a fraction of the albedo it shows. 0 when absent.

rim_power.description: How tight the rim hugs the silhouette; higher is thinner. 3 when absent.

min_brightness.description: The least an actor reflects, a fraction of its albedo's luminance. 0 when absent.

room_tint.description: How much of the room's light colour tints actors: 0 keeps the albedo's hue. 1 when absent.

fog.description: Haze that takes a share of what is drawn towards its colour with the distance from the camera: 1 - e^(-density x metres past start), or the ramp from start to end, whichever is thicker. The background stays as it is. Off when absent; a game tweens fog.density, fog.color.r/g/b, fog.start and fog.end.

color.description: Linear RGB. The background's bottom when absent.

density.description: The share of light lost per metre past start. 0 when absent.

start.description: Metres from the camera where the fog begins. 0 when absent.

end.description: Metres from the camera where the ramp from start covers everything; at or before start, no ramp. 0 when absent.

textures.description: How colour textures are stored. ASTC 4x4 (the default) needs a GPU that samples ASTC; RGBA8 is four times larger.

collision.description: What to bake into the room's collision pack (.srmc, written beside the room pack); no collision pack when absent. Every placed piece becomes a collider named like a loose draw (<room>.<piece>, <room>.<piece>.<n> for the n-th copy). Positions are on the engine's axes: Y up, north is -Z, metres; yaw_deg turns about +Y, 0 facing +Z.

exclude.description: Pieces that get no collider (rugs, grass, decals).

as_mesh.description: Pieces baked as their simplified triangles whatever their shape.

as_hull.description: Pieces baked as their convex hull.

as_box.description: Pieces baked as the box around them in their own frame.

primitives.description: Colliders no piece draws, such as invisible blockers or a simpler stand-in for an excluded piece.

triggers.description: Named volumes whose entry and exit the simulation reports.

actors.description: Actor colliders: radius and height (and head) given, or fitted to visual_bounds (and head_bounds).

spots.description: Where an actor stands for an action: its feet and facing.

routes.description: Pairs of spot names a script walks between; sariema check searches a path for each, with the first spot's actor.

traversals.description: Scripted moves with the actor's collider off, such as climbing in through a window; sariema check proves that each ends on free floor and that its contacts lie on a surface.

simplify_error.description: Metres simplification may move a mesh collider's surface; a piece thinner than this keeps its triangles. 0.02 when absent.

hull_points.description: Most points a hull collider keeps. 32 when absent.

box_fill.description: Share of its box a piece's hull must fill for the box to stand for it. 0.85 when absent.

hull_tolerance.description: Metres a hull's surface may stand off the piece's for the hull to stand for it. 0.05 when absent.

collision_capsule.description: The points within radius of the segment a-b.

enabled.description: Whether it blocks from the start. true when absent.

collision_bounds.description: A box in the actor's frame: feet at the origin, facing +Z.

height.description: Feet to the top of the body capsule; at least twice the radius.
Of the centre above the feet.

forward.description: Of the centre ahead of the body's axis. 0 when absent.

visual_bounds.description: What the model covers; sariema check warns when it exceeds the collider.

head_bounds.description: The head's part of visual_bounds, fitted with a head sphere.

from.description: The spot it starts from; its actor is the one carried.

points.description: The feet along the way; the last is where the actor stands again.

yaw_deg.description: Facing at the end. 0 when absent.

collision_contact.description: A point of an authored pose that rests on a surface on purpose, like a foot hooked on a sill.
